frames.narration: Three connections are registered with the reactor, each with a handler. All three are quiet.
The reactor asks the selector which connections are ready. It sleeps until something happens.
Connections 2 and 1 receive data. The selector reports them as ready.
The reactor calls each ready connection's handler in turn. Each handler is quick and does not block.
Back to the selector. The next batch has connection 3 only, so it is handled alone. One thread served all three.
A handler that blocked for 200 ms here would hold up every other connection, so slow or heavy work goes to a worker pool.
